sections.title: Introduction
sections.hint: Brief lead-in; the substance is in the subsections.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.hint: Why this SRS exists and who reads it.

sections.title: Scope
sections.hint: What the system will and will not do, where it runs, and who uses it.

sections.title: Definitions, acronyms, and abbreviations
sections.hint: Terms a reader might not know, as a table: term, meaning.

sections.title: Product perspective
sections.hint: How the system fits its context: what it replaces or connects to.

sections.title: User classes and characteristics
sections.hint: User roles, their skills, and how their needs shape the design.

sections.title: Operating environment
sections.hint: Hardware, operating systems, browsers, network, and hosting.

sections.title: Assumptions and dependencies
sections.hint: What the specification assumes or depends on.

sections.title: Functional requirements
sections.hint: Lead-in: one subsection per menu or feature.

sections.title: Feature
sections.hint: For this item: purpose, users, inputs, processing, outputs, business rules, and error cases. Numbered requirements (FR-x).

sections.title: Performance
sections.hint: Response times, throughput, and data volumes.

sections.title: Security
sections.hint: Authentication, authorisation, data protection, and audit.

sections.title: External interfaces
sections.hint: Other systems, APIs, files, and devices the system talks to.

sections.title: Appendix
sections.hint: Anything that supports the document: diagrams, references, open questions.
